title: Halloween Alphabet Hunt
description: Practice uppercase letter recognition, beginning sounds, big and little letter matching, visual discrimination, and alphabet order with six friendly Halloween activities.
learningFocus: Recognize uppercase letters A to Z, connect familiar Halloween pictures to beginning letters, match uppercase and lowercase forms, and identify letters in alphabet order.
adultGuidance: Print one page at a time and let your child try before checking together. Say letter names aloud, describe uppercase and lowercase pairs as big and little forms, and use the A to Z checklist as part of the alphabet hunt; the activities are designed to be checked together without a separate answer key.
